summary: Last submission of the run, and it goes after the one residual the previous interpretation named rather than restating anything: whether buffering the apply channel lets a queue accumulate behind a slow FSM, since that is the configuration in which the caller stops throttling itself. The harness now contrasts the two channel configurations with the same 25ms FSM and the same flood of unwaited applies, timing VerifyLeader as a main-loop probe and recording the backlog between the last log index and the last applied index plus whether that backlog exceeded one batch. Native feedback from the local dry run, explicitly not retained evidence: neither configuration accumulated — the backlog stayed at zero with the buffered channel and one entry without it, and the probe came back in zero to a few milliseconds — because each commit's delivery to the FSM still gates the main loop regardless of how the apply channel is buffered. Both comparisons are declared so the retained receipt decides the residual either way, and if it reproduces the dry run then the FSM-latency question closes with the leak confirmed as real but per-batch and self-throttling in both supported channel configurations. That is where the run ends, and it is a fitting place: every registered question is answered, and the last three answers were narrowings of my own earlier readings — the source-only part-answer on FSM backpressure, the stronger stall phrasing, and now its named residual — each corrected by a measurement or a receipt rather than left standing. The record holds three execution-grounded findings with their retained receipts, declared comparisons, witnesses and scoped conditions — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft once the committed-but-unapplied window exceeds the FSM channel's batch capacity, the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum and can accompany committed state the confirming leader never applied, and the membership change that installs a voter immediately against two published descriptions that promise staging — alongside five suspicions refuted with evidence, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, and no necessary gap outstanding.
